description: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) of four different model configurations as a function of the activated parameters ratio, expressed as a percentage and plotted in reverse order from 100% to 25% on the x-axis, with major tick labels at 100, 75, 50, and 25. The y-axis, labeled “Eval PPL,” uses a linear scale ranging from 11.5 to 14.0, with tick marks and labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line, labeled “Transformer,” remains flat across all activation ratios, maintaining a constant PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers, representing “Only MoHD FFN,” begins at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, dips slightly to 11.2 at 50%, then increases to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The dark blue line with circular markers, labeled “Only MoHD ATTN,” starts at 11.5 and rises steeply to a PPL of about 14.0 at 25%. The light blue line with cross markers, corresponding to “MoHD ATTN + MLP,” also begins at 11.5 and increases steadily to approximately 13.8 at 25%. A legend in the top-left corner identifies each line by method, color, and marker style.
caption_used: The line plot illustrates the evaluation perplexity (PPL) across varying ratios of activated parameters measured in percentage. The x-axis is labeled as 'Activated Parameters Ratio (%)' and ranges from 25 to 100 in reverse order, with tick labels at intervals of 25. The y-axis is labeled 'Eval PPL' with a linear scale from 11.5 to 14.0 and tick labels at intervals of 0.5. The red dashed line labeled 'Transformer' remains horizontal across the x-axis at a PPL of approximately 11.6. The gray line with square markers for 'Only MoHD FFN' starts at a PPL of about 11.5 at 100% activation, decreases slightly to a PPL of 11.2 at 50%, then rises again to approximately 11.8 at 25%. The purple line with circle markers for 'Only MoHD ATTN' starts at about 11.5, rises significantly to around 14.0 at 25%. The blue line with cross markers for 'MoHD ATTN + MLP' begins at 11.5 and follows an upward trend to approximately 13.8 at 25%. A legend is placed at the top left corner of the plot, indicating the methods compared.
